fact: On 23 February 2026 PPDAA's Acting Board Chairperson said South Sudan has entered the implementation phase of procurement reform and that procuring entities must publish procurement information, tender opportunities and contract awards on the PPDAA Tender Portal.
title: PPDAA Conducts Second 10-Day Capacity-Building Training Programme on Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets
publisher: Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets Authority (PPDAA)
